load_image_processor_from_pretrained: load an image processor from a pretrained model name or local path using from_pretrained
save_image_processor_to_directory: save an image processor configuration to a directory as a JSON file using save_pretrained
push_image_processor_to_hub: push an image processor to the Hugging Face model hub using push_to_hub
serialize_image_processor_to_dict: serialize an image processor instance to a Python dictionary using to_dict
register_image_processor_for_auto_class: register a custom image processor class with AutoImageProcessor using register_for_auto_class
